name: use-role-guard
title: useRoleGuard
description: The user object. If not provided, attempts to read from session storage.

parameters.name: requiredRoles
parameters.description: - The list of roles required to access the resource.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - Configuration options including user object and redirect paths.

properties.name: user
properties.description: The user object. If not provided, attempts to read from session storage.

properties.name: redirectTo
properties.description: URL to redirect to if access is denied.

properties.name: fallbackComponent
properties.description: Component to render while loading or if unauthorized (not fully implemented in hook logic, mainly for HOCs).

properties.name: onUnauthorized
properties.description: Callback fired when access is denied.

properties.name: sessionKey
properties.description: The key used to fetch user data from sessionStorage.

returnType.name: UseRoleGuardReturn
returnType.description: Access status, user data, and role checking utilities.

properties.name: hasAccess
properties.description: Whether the user has the required roles.

properties.name: hasAnyRole
properties.description: Checks if the user has at least one of the provided roles.

properties.name: hasAllRoles
properties.description: Checks if the user has all of the provided roles.

properties.name: isLoading
properties.description: Whether user data is being loaded.

properties.name: checkAccess
properties.description: Manually checks access against a specific set of roles.

properties.name: redirect
properties.description: Function to trigger the redirect manually.
